title.narrative: Sustainable land use management and farmer field schools for forest protection

description.narrative: One of the last forests in the eastern mountain range of the Andes is in the province of Carchi in northern Ecuador. Its ecosystem is severely endangered by various interests of use, such as the conversion of natural forests into arable and pastureland. The Carchi Decentralized Autonomous Protected Area was created in 2015 to protect, conserve, and restore threatened ecosystems. The project supported the management of the protected area. Through strengthening the capacity of the local population, it increased environmentally friendly activities in the area. It also developped plans that protect the natural resources, integrating local interests. It further produced and disseminated scientific knowledge on local biodiversity. The project cooperated with provincial and local governments and is based on a participatory, multi-stakeholder approach. By this, the same methods could also be used in other regions.
